Account wallet :.description:
> Choose whether to display the wallet balance next to the account name.

- Hide : Hide the wallet balance.
- Show : Show the wallet balance.

Avatar status border :.description:
> Choose how the avatar status border appears in the top bar account block.

- Default : Use the default Minimal Dark border.
- Hide : Hide the status border.
- Reduce : Reduce the border size on hover.
- User color : Use the selected user color for the border.

Bigger notification button :.description:
> Choose whether to enlarge the notification button.

- No : Use Steam's default notification button size.
- Yes : Use a larger notification button.

Compact avatar :.description:
> Choose whether to use a compact account avatar block.

- Compact : Use a compact block that expands on hover.
- Default : Use Steam's default account avatar block.

Alternative color for received/sent mess.description:
> Choose the colors used for sent and received messages in conversations.

- Colored : Use blue for sent messages and light green for received messages.
- Default Steam colors : Use off-white for sent messages and gray for received messages.

Alternative normal view for favorite con.description:
> Use a smaller normal layout for favorite contacts while keeping contact names visible.

- No : Use the default normal layout.
- Yes : Use the reduced normal layout.

Note : This option only works when compact mode for favorite contacts is disabled in Steam's settings.

Animated hovering :.description:
> Choose whether contacts animate when hovered in the friends list.

- No : Disable the hover animation.
- Yes : Slide contact text to the right on hover.

Avatar size :.description:
> Choose the avatar size used in the friends list.

- Default : Use medium avatars.
- Large (known issues) : Use large avatars. Display issues may occur depending on the game description length and friends list window size.
- Small : Use small avatars.

Font size :.description:
> Choose the friends list font size. This setting does not apply in compact mode.

- Default : Use Steam's default font size.
- Smaller : Use a smaller font size.

Friends conversation tabs header glow :.description:
> Choose the glow and status dot displayed on conversation tabs.

- Default : Show the yellow glow and yellow dot.
- Hide (only red dot) : Hide the glow and show only the red dot.
- Hide (only user color dot) : Hide the glow and show only the user-color dot.
- Hide (only yellow dot) : Hide the glow and show only the yellow dot.
- User color : Show a user-color glow and user-color dot.

Friends list header glow :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the glow behind the profile picture in the friends list.

- No : Keep the glow effect.
- Yes : Hide the glow effect.

Group chat position :.description:
> Choose the position of the group chat block.

- Default (bottom) : Keep Steam's default bottom position.
- Hide : Hide the group chat block.
- Top : Move the group chat block to the top.

Hide footer :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the footer in the friends list.

- No : Show the footer.
- Yes : Hide the bottom footer bar.

Hide footer (fix) :.description:
> Enable the animated replacement for the create-group-chat icon when the friends list footer is hidden.

- No : Do not apply the replacement.
- Yes : Apply the animated replacement.

Hide voice chat :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the voice chat button in conversations.

- No : Show the voice chat button.
- Yes : Hide the voice chat button.

Inverted contact block :.description:
> Choose the alignment of avatars and text in the contact list.

- No : Place avatars on the left and text on the right.
- Yes : Place avatars on the right and text on the left.

Offline friends :.description:
> Choose whether to display the Offline Friends section in the friends list.

- Hide : Hide the section. Offline friends remain available through search.
- Show : Show the Offline Friends section.

Alternative view for back to top button.description:
> Choose the appearance of the back-to-top button shown while scrolling a game page.

- No : Use the default appearance.
- Yes : Use the alternative appearance.

Alternative view for scrolling block :.description:
> Choose the appearance of the game header shown while scrolling a game page.

- No : Use the default header.
- Yes : Use the alternative header.

Always show game information :.description:
> Choose whether to keep game information visible without opening the information panel.

- No : Use the default behavior.
- Yes : Always display the game information.

Bigger gamepage/library buttons :.description:
> Choose the size of Play, Install, and Download buttons on game pages and in the library.

- No : Use the medium Minimal Dark button size.
- Yes : Use larger buttons.

Bigger header :.description:
> Choose the size and mask of the image at the top of game pages.

- Full image everywhere : Use the full-size image in normal and maximized windows.
- Full image everywhere (no mask) : Use the full-size image everywhere without the dark mask.
- Full image only when maximized : Use the full-size image only when the window is maximized.
- Full image only when maximized (no mask) : Use the full-size image only when maximized, without the dark mask.
- Minimal default : Use the default Minimal Dark size.
- Minimal default (no mask) : Use the default Minimal Dark size without the dark mask.
- Steam default : Use Steam's default size.

Bigger top block padding :.description:
> Choose whether to increase the padding around the top game page block.

- No : Use the default padding.
- Yes : Use larger padding.

Blurred background :.description:
> Choose the background style used on game pages.

- Blurred : Blur the upper part of the game page.
- Full dark : Use a solid dark background (#121212) across the entire game page.

Community content :.description:
> Choose whether to display community content on game pages.

- Hide : Hide community content. This may improve performance on slower PCs.
- Show : Show community content.

Compact gamepage :.description:
> Use a compact game page that focuses on news, achievements, and screenshots.

- No : Use the default game page layout.
- Yes : Hide DLC, friends who play, and review sections.

Dropdown stream/play button :.description:
> Choose whether to display the dropdown arrow on Play, Stream, and Install buttons.

- No : Hide the dropdown arrow.
- Yes : Show the dropdown arrow.

Gamepage/library buttons SVG color (Play.description:
> Choose the SVG icon color used by Play and Install buttons.

- Same as the outline : Match the icon color to the button outline.
- White : Use white icons.

Header (compact mode) :.description:
> Choose whether to display the header image when compact mode is enabled.

- Hide : Hide the header image to save space.
- Show : Show the header image.

Header size adjustment :.description:
> Choose whether game page header images fill their entire container.

- No : Keep Steam's default image size.
- Yes : Stretch the image to fill the header block.

Hide 'post-party summary' / 'WYRTG?' :.description:
> Choose which post-game panels are displayed on game pages.

- Hide all : Hide both panels.
- Show 'WYRTG?' only : Show only the recommendation prompt.
- Show all : Show both panels.
- Show post-party summary only : Show only the post-game summary.

Hide achievement dates :.description:
> Choose whether to hide achievement unlock dates.

- No : Show achievement unlock dates.
- Yes : Hide achievement unlock dates.

Hide all activities :.description:
> Choose how activity items are displayed on game pages.

- Hide all activities : Hide the entire activity feed.
- Hide only the no activities message : Hide only the message shown when no recent activity is available.
- Show all activities : Always show the activity feed.
- Show all activities on hover : Show the activity feed only on hover.

Hide category names :.description:
> Choose whether to hide category names on game pages.

- No : Show category names.
- Yes : Hide category names.

Inverted gamepage (known bugs) :.description:
> Choose whether to reverse the game page block layout.

- Default : Use Steam's default block order.
- Inverted : Reverse the block order. Display issues may occur, and this layout is incompatible with visible community content.

Text on play/download buttons :.description:
> Choose whether Play, Stop, and Download buttons display text next to their icons.

- No : Show icons only.
- Yes : Show text next to the icons.

Alternative border color for context men.description:
> Choose the border color used by menus and context menus.

- Black : Use black borders.
- Grey : Use gray borders.

Alternative topbar color :.description:
> Choose the color scheme used by the top bar.

- Dark : Use a fully dark top bar.
- Grey : Use a fully gray top bar.
- Grey/dark : Use a gray top bar with dark buttons.

Alternative UI color for context menus/m.description:
> Choose whether to invert the colors of menus and context menus.

- No : Use the default colors.
- Yes : Use the inverted colors.

Animation for context menus/menus :.description:
> Choose the opening animation used by menus and context menus.

- No animation : Open instantly.
- Reveal from bottom : Reveal from bottom to top. This option is not recommended.
- Reveal from center : Reveal outward from the center.
- Reveal from left : Reveal from left to right.
- Reveal from right : Reveal from right to left.
- Reveal from sides : Reveal from both sides toward the center.
- Reveal from top : Reveal from top to bottom.

Avatar frame :.description:
> Choose whether to display avatar frames throughout the interface.

- Hide : Hide all avatar frames.
- Show : Show avatar frames.

Note : To display animated avatars and avatar frames, enable the corresponding option in Steam under Contacts and Chat.

Compact menus/context menus :.description:
> Choose the size, animation, and optional left border used by menus and context menus.

- Compact size (animated with left border) : Use compact spacing, animated rows, and a left border.
- Compact size (animated) : Use compact spacing with animated rows.
- Compact size (static with left border) : Use compact spacing, static rows, and a left border.
- Compact size (static) : Use compact spacing with static rows.
- Default size (animated with left border) : Use default spacing, animated rows, and a left border.
- Default size (animated) : Use default spacing with animated rows.
- Default size (static with left border) : Use default spacing, static rows, and a left border.
- Default size (static) : Use default spacing with static rows.

Context menu left icons :.description:
> Choose the size and style of icons displayed to the left of context menu entries.

- Default : Do not add icons.
- User color icons (big/fill) : Use large filled icons with the user color on hover.
- User color icons (big/outline) : Use large outlined icons with the user color on hover.
- User color icons (small/fill) : Use small filled icons with the user color on hover.
- User color icons (small/outline) : Use small outlined icons with the user color on hover.

Note : Choose an icon size that matches the context menu size selected above. Large icons also work in compact mode but slightly increase row height.

Corner radius :.description:
> Choose the corner radius used throughout the interface.

- More rounded : Use a 10 px radius.
- Rounded : Use a 5 px radius.
- Square : Use square corners with a 0 px radius.

Hover borders on library and WebKit bloc.description:
> Choose whether hovered library and WebKit items use a full border or a bottom border only.

- Bottom only : Apply the user color only to the bottom border.
- Full borders : Apply the user color to every border.

Resize grip (Steam windows) :.description:
> Choose the appearance of the resize grip used by Steam windows.

- Alternative UI : Use the alternative resize grip.
- Alternative UI (smaller) : Use a smaller alternative resize grip.
- Default : Use Steam's default resize grip.
- Default (smaller) : Use a smaller version of Steam's default resize grip.
- Hide : Hide the resize grip.

Note : If you hide the resize grip, disable the Friends option named Hidden footer icon fix.

Steam Big Picture button :.description:
> Choose whether to display the Steam Big Picture button in the top bar.

- Hide : Hide the button.
- Show : Show the button.

Steam News button :.description:
> Choose whether to display the Steam News button in the top bar.

- Hide : Hide the button.
- Show : Show the button.

Title area buttons :.description:
> Choose the size of the Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons.

- Enlarged (Windows 10) : Use enlarged buttons designed for Windows 10.
- Enlarged (Windows 11) : Use enlarged buttons designed for Windows 11.
- Small : Use small title bar buttons.

Vanilla topbar style :.description:
> Choose between the Minimal Dark and vanilla Steam top bar layouts.

- Minimal Dark : Place all top bar buttons on one row.
- Vanilla topbar : Use Steam's two-row top bar layout.

Alternative game names hover effect :.description:
> Choose the hover border used by game titles in the What's New section.

- Alternative #1 : Show a user-color bottom border.
- Alternative #2 : Show a full user-color border.
- Default : Show a user-color left border.

Alternative library navigation button :.description:
> Choose the appearance of navigation arrows on library shelves.

- Alternative : Show arrows with gray borders.
- Default : Show arrows only.

Alternative view of in-game friends :.description:
> Choose the layout of in-game friend icons in the library.

- Alternative : Place the icons below the game block.
- Default : Use the default layout.

Animated button hover :.description:
> Choose whether Play, Install, and Stop buttons animate on hover in the library and on game pages.

- No : Disable the hover animation.
- Yes : Enable the hover animation.

Compact collections :.description:
> Choose whether to reduce the spacing between game covers in collections.

- No : Use Steam's default spacing.
- Yes : Use reduced spacing.

Compact filters :.description:
> Choose whether to reduce the spacing in the library filter block.

- No : Use Steam's default filter spacing.
- Yes : Use compact filter spacing.

Compact labels (library + What's New) :.description:
> Choose the layout of date labels in the library and What's New section.

- Compact : Attach compact labels to the top border.
- Compact (bottom) : Attach compact labels to the bottom border in the library.
- Default : Use detached labels at the top.
- Default (bottom) : Use detached labels at the bottom in the library.

Compact library :.description:
> Choose whether to reduce the spacing between game covers in the library.

- No : Use Steam's default spacing.
- Yes : Use reduced spacing.

Compact mode :.description:
> Choose which search and filter controls are visible in the sidebar.

- Compact : Hide the filter controls.
- Default : Show the search and filter controls.
- Ultra compact : Hide both the search and filter controls.

Compact news container :.description:
> Choose the size and layout of the What's New section.

- Compact #1 : Use a compact layout with smaller text.
- Compact #2 : Use a compact layout with normal-size text.
- Steam default : Use Steam's default layout.
- Ultra compact : Show text only and fit more news items.
- Ultra compact (center content) : Use the ultra-compact layout with centered content.

Download icon on uninstalled games :.description:
> Choose whether to display download icons on uninstalled games in the library.

- Hide : Hide the download icons.
- Show : Show the download icons.

Hide shelf :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the Add Shelf button in the library.

- No : Show the Add Shelf button.
- Yes : Hide the Add Shelf button.

Label color for completed games :.description:
> Choose the appearance of labels shown on 100% completed games.

- Compact : Use a compact user-color label with white text and a medal.
- Compact (bottom) : Use the compact label at the bottom.
- Default : Use a default-size user-color label with white text and a medal.
- Default (bottom) : Use the default-size label at the bottom.
- Minimal : Use a blurred background, user-color text, and no medal.

Note : Choose a layout that matches the Compact library labels option.

Library game hover glow color :.description:
> Choose the glow color used when hovering over game artwork in the library.

- Default : Use a white glow.
- User color : Use the selected user color.

Library labels :.description:
> Choose where date labels such as Today, Yesterday, and Last Week are displayed.

- Hide all : Hide labels in both the library and What's New section.
- Hide library only : Hide labels in the library only.
- Hide What's new only : Hide labels in the What's New section only.
- Show : Show labels in both locations.

News container :.description:
> Choose whether to display the What's New section in the library.

- Hide : Hide the What's New section.
- Show : Show the What's New section.

Static hovering (landscape games of Rece.description:
> Choose the hover effect used by landscape game artwork in Recent Games and Play Next.

- Animated : Use the animated hover effect.
- Static : Use a static hover effect.

Static hovering (portrait games of Libra.description:
> Choose the hover effect used by portrait game artwork in the library and collections.

- Animated : Use the animated hover effect.
- Static : Use a static hover effect.

Hours played :.description:
> Choose whether to display the Hours Played block on mini-profiles.

- Hide : Hide the Hours Played block.
- Show : Show the Hours Played block.

Mini-profile background :.description:
> Choose whether to display profile images and videos in mini-profile backgrounds.

- Hide : Use a black background with an acrylic effect.
- Show : Display the mini-profile background image or video.

Bigger buttons :.description:
> Choose whether to enlarge overlay buttons.

- No : Use the default button size.
- Yes : Use larger buttons.

No button labels in list mode :.description:
> Choose whether to hide overlay button labels in list mode.

- No : Show button labels.
- Yes : Hide button labels and show icons only.

No button labels in normal mode :.description:
> Choose whether to hide overlay button labels in normal mode.

- No : Show button labels.
- Yes : Hide button labels and show icons only.

Notification toast border color :.description:
> Choose where notification toast borders use the selected user color.

- User color on all borders : Apply the user color to every border.
- User color on top : Apply the user color to the top border only.

Notification toast text color :.description:
> Choose the text color used in notification toasts.

- Default : Use white text.
- User color : Use the selected user color.

Millennium sidebar background.description:
> Choose the background style used for the Millennium sidebar.

- Acrylic : Use the default acrylic background.
- Solid dark color : Use a solid dark background.

Alternative hover effect :.description:
> Choose the hover effect used by games in the sidebar.

- Default : Show a user-color left border.
- User color gradient : Show a user-color left border and gradient.

Alternative in-game friends indicator :.description:
> Choose the indicator used for friends who are currently in game.

- Dot #1 : Use a rounded dot.
- Dot #2 : Use a small rounded dot.
- Dot #3 : Use a square dot.
- Dot #4 : Use a small square dot.
- Minimal Dark alternative #1 : Use the alternative vertical bar.
- Minimal Dark alternative #2 : Use a horizontal bar.
- Minimal Dark default : Use the default vertical bar.

Alternative update color :.description:
> Choose the color of game update notifications in the sidebar.

- Default : Use green.
- User color : Use the selected user color.

Animated mouseover :.description:
> Choose whether game entries animate when hovered in the sidebar.

- No : Disable the hover animation.
- Yes : Enable the hover animation.

Bigger font size :.description:
> Choose whether to enlarge game names in the sidebar.

- No : Use the normal font size.
- Yes : Use a larger font size.

Bolder names :.description:
> Choose whether game names in the sidebar use a bolder font weight.

- No : Use the normal font weight.
- Yes : Use a bolder font weight.

Game name overflow :.description:
> Choose whether long game names remain inside the sidebar.

- No : Allow game names to overflow and display in full.
- Yes : Keep game names within the sidebar on hover.

Hide left images :.description:
> Choose whether to hide game cover icons beside names in the sidebar.

- No : Show game cover icons.
- Yes : Hide game cover icons.

Installed/selected game color :.description:
> Choose the colors used for installed and selected games.

- Minimal Dark : Use beige names and the user color for the selected game.
- Minimal Dark alternative : Use white names and the user color for the selected game.
- White : Use white for both game names and the selected game.

Persistent sidebar :.description:
> Choose whether to keep the sidebar visible on WebKit, Community, and profile pages.

- No : Hide the sidebar on those pages.
- Yes : Show the sidebar on those pages.

Note : The main filter is not accessible on WebKit pages when this option is enabled.

Pointer fix :.description:
> Choose whether to fix the sidebar resize pointer when Persistent sidebar is disabled.

- No : Use this setting when Persistent sidebar is enabled.
- Yes : Use this setting when Persistent sidebar is disabled.

Resize width :.description:
> Choose whether the sidebar uses a fixed width or can be resized manually.

- Fixed position : Use a fixed sidebar width.
- Manual resize : Allow the sidebar to be resized manually.

Note : This option is not compatible with Persistent sidebar.

Right sidebar :.description:
> Choose which side of the Steam window displays the sidebar.

- Left : Place the sidebar on the left.
- Right : Place the sidebar on the right. The resize handle still moves toward the right.

Selected uninstalled game color :.description:
> Choose the color used for selected uninstalled games.

- Minimal Dark : Use red.
- User color : Use the selected user color.
- White : Use white.

Show sidebar on mouseover :.description:
> Choose whether the sidebar remains visible or appears only on hover.

- Default : Keep the sidebar visible.
- On hover : Show the sidebar when hovered.

Note : Advanced filters and filter buttons are unavailable in hover mode.

Alignment fix for 4K resolution :.description:
> Choose whether to apply the top bar alignment fix for 4K displays.

- No : Do not apply the fix.
- Yes : Apply the alignment fix.

Alternative contacts icon :.description:
> Choose the contacts icon used in the top bar.

- Minimal Dark #1 (fill) : Use the filled rounded icon.
- Minimal Dark #1 (outline) : Use the outlined rounded icon.
- Minimal Dark #2 (fill) : Use the filled phone icon.
- Minimal Dark #2 (outline) : Use the outlined phone icon.
- Minimal Dark #3 (fill) : Use the filled chat bubble icon.
- Minimal Dark #3 (outline) : Use the outlined chat bubble icon.

Alternative downloads UI :.description:
> Choose the appearance of the Downloads button in the top bar.

- Minimal Dark : Use the default Minimal Dark interface.
- New UI : Use the compact new interface.
- New UI (alt) : Use the compact new interface with a thinner progress line.
- Vanilla rework : Use a reworked vanilla interface with Minimal Dark styling.
- Vanilla rework (text only) : Use the reworked vanilla interface with text only.

Alternative underlining :.description:
> Choose the style and position of the underline beneath the selected top bar tab.

- Default (bold line) : Use a bold line in the default position.
- Default (thin line) : Use a thin line in the default position.
- Fade (bold line) : Use a bold fading line.
- Fade (thin line) : Use a thin fading line.
- To the left (bold line) : Use a bold line aligned to the left.
- To the left (thin line) : Use a thin line aligned to the left.
- To the right (bold line) : Use a bold line aligned to the right.
- To the right (thin line) : Use a thin line aligned to the right.

Download progress bar color :.description:
> Choose the color of the download progress bar.

- No : Use green.
- Yes : Use the selected user color.

Hide topbar elements :.description:
> Choose which menus, navigation arrows, and tabs are visible in the top bar.

- Hide all : Hide menus, arrows, and tabs.
- Hide all (for vanilla top bar style option) : Hide all elements when using the vanilla top bar style.
- Hide arrows only : Hide navigation arrows only.
- Hide arrows only (for vanilla top bar style option) : Hide navigation arrows when using the vanilla top bar style.
- Hide menus only : Hide root menus only.
- Hide menus only (for vanilla top bar style option) : Hide root menus when using the vanilla top bar style.
- Show all : Show every top bar element.

Note : Use the vanilla-specific choices only when Vanilla top bar style is enabled.

Hide topbar tabs :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the WebKit and Community tabs.

- Hide WebKit and Community : Hide both tabs.
- Show all : Show all top bar tabs.

Hover/active borders :.description:
> Choose whether hovered and active top bar items use full borders.

- No : Show the top border only.
- Yes : Show full borders.

Larger font :.description:
> Choose the font size used by the Steam root menu and top bar tabs.

- Default size : Use 13 px text.
- Larger size (excluding wallet) : Use 18 px text while keeping the wallet text smaller.
- Larger size (including wallet) : Use 18 px text, including the wallet text.
- Medium size (alt, excluding wallet) : Use 16 px text while keeping the wallet text smaller.
- Medium size (alt, including wallet) : Use 16 px text, including the wallet text.
- Medium size (excluding wallet) : Use 15 px text while keeping the wallet text smaller.
- Medium size (including wallet) : Use 15 px text, including the wallet text.

Larger font (fix) :.description:
> Choose whether to apply the root menu text fix when Larger font is enabled.

- No : Use this choice when the word Steam is already visible.
- Yes : Use this choice when the word Steam is hidden.

Longer tabs :.description:
> Choose whether to increase the width of top bar tabs.

- No : Use the normal tab width.
- Yes : Use wider tabs.

Root menu Steam text :.description:
> Choose whether to display the word Steam beside the root menu icon.

- Hide : Hide the text.
- Show : Show the text.

Steam menu activation :.description:
> Choose how Steam menus are opened.

- On click : Open menus with a mouse click.
- On hover : Open menus by hovering over them.

 NOTE : Mouse clicks are disabled when a hover option is selected.

Steam tab submenus activation :.description:
> Choose how Steam tab submenus are opened.

- On click : Open submenus by clicking their tabs.
- On hover : Open submenus by hovering over their tabs.

 NOTE : For the “On click” option, a single click opens the tab’s submenu. To access the tab’s link, double-click it.

Steam topbar visibility :.description:
> Choose how the Steam topbar is displayed.

- Collapsed : Keep only the Steam root menu visible. Single-click it to open its submenu, and double-click it to reveal or hide the rest of the topbar.
- Collapsed (Steam root menu text shown) : The same option, but only if you do not display the root menu text.
- Default : Keep all Steam menus, arrows, and tabs visible.

 NOTE #1 : The topbar remains expanded after a double-click. Double-click the Steam root menu again to collapse it.
 NOTE #2 : This option is not compatible with the global “Vanilla topbar style” option.

Tabs text transform :.description:
> Choose the capitalization used by top bar tab labels.

- No : Use lowercase labels.
- Yes : Capitalize the labels.

Topbar menu icon hover effect :.description:
> Choose the hover effect used by top bar menu icons.

- Fill : Use a filled hover effect.
- Outline : Use an outlined hover effect.

Topbar Store tab left icon (currency ico.description:
> Choose the currency icon displayed beside the Store tab.

- Fill icon (dollar) : Use a filled dollar icon.
- Fill icon (euro) : Use a filled euro icon.
- Fill icon (pound sterling) : Use a filled pound sterling icon.
- No icon : Hide the currency icon.
- Outline icon (dollar) : Use an outlined dollar icon.
- Outline icon (euro) : Use an outlined euro icon.
- Outline icon (pound sterling) : Use an outlined pound sterling icon.

Topbar tabs left icons (hover effect inc.description:
> Choose whether top bar tabs display filled icons, outlined icons, or text only.

- Icons active (fill + text) : Show filled icons and text.
- Icons active (outline + text) : Show outlined icons and text.
- No icons (text only) : Hide the icons and show text only.

Topbar tabs left icons, no text :.description:
> Choose whether top bar tabs display icons without text.

- No : Show both icons and text.
- Yes : Show icons only.

Alternative root menu icon :.description:
> Choose the icon displayed on the Steam root menu button.

- Minimal Dark : Use the half Steam logo.
- Minimal Dark #1 : Use the full Steam logo.
- Minimal Dark #2 : Use the filled rounded Steam logo.
- Minimal Dark #3 : Use the outlined rounded Steam logo.
- Minimal Dark #4 : Use the filled square Steam logo.
- Minimal Dark #5 : Use the outlined square Steam logo.

Animated titlebar :.description:
> This option animates the title area (minimize, maximize/restore, and close buttons).

- No : Static titlebar.
- Yes : Animate the titlebar.

Change UI font :.description:
> Choose the font used throughout the interface.

- Default : Use the default interface font.
- DePixel : Use DePixel.
- JetBrains : Use JetBrains Mono.
- Maria : Use Maria.
- Monaco : Use Monaco.
- Orbitron : Use Orbitron.
- Roboto : Use Roboto.
- Share Tech : Use Share Tech.
- Sudo Var : Use Sudo Var.

Note : Some fonts may conflict with Steam text in the root menu when that option is disabled.

Default pointers :.description:
> Choose the pointer style used throughout the interface.

- Minimal Dark : Use a consistent Minimal Dark pointer everywhere.
- Steam : Use Steam's default pointers.

Hide scrollbars :.description:
> Choose whether to display scrollbars throughout the interface.

- Hide : Hide all scrollbars.
- Show : Show all scrollbars.

Mouseover animation of settings menu tab.description:
> Choose whether category tabs in Settings animate on hover.

- Animated : Use animated hover effects.
- Static : Use static hover effects.

No titlebar (Linux) :.description:
> Hide the title bar when using a tiled window manager on Linux.

- No : Keep the title bar. Use this setting on Windows.
- Yes : Hide the title bar for keyboard-driven tiled window managers on Linux.

Note : Leave this option disabled on Windows.

Pure black color (OLED) :.description:
> Choose whether to use pure black backgrounds for OLED displays.

- No : Use the default dark colors.
- Yes : Use pure black backgrounds.

Windows 10 corner fix :.description:
> Choose whether to correct the upper-left and upper-right window corners on Windows 10.

- No : Do not apply the Windows 10 corner fix.
- Yes : Apply the Windows 10 corner fix.

Note : When this option is enabled, disable Top bar corner consistency.

Windows corner fix :.description:
> Choose whether all top bar buttons use the same corner radius.

- No : Keep the default corner radius values.
- Yes : Use the same corner radius for every top bar button.

Note : When this option is enabled, disable Windows 10 corner fix.

Alternative UI for new Steam menu :.description:
> Choose an alternative layout for the new Steam Store menu.

- Minimal new UI : Use the standard Minimal Dark layout.
- Minimal new UI (buttons) : Use the Minimal Dark layout with buttons.
- Minimal new UI (compact buttons) : Use the compact Minimal Dark layout with buttons.
- Minimal new UI (compact) : Use the compact Minimal Dark layout.
- Ultra compact : Show only the icon at the default size.
- Ultra compact #1 : Show only the icon at a compact size.

Block backgrounds :.description:
> Choose the background style used by news and game update blocks.

- Blurred : Use blurred backgrounds.
- Full dark : Use solid dark backgrounds without transparency.

Carousel arrow borders :.description:
> Choose whether to display borders around carousel arrows on WebKit pages.

- No : Hide carousel arrow borders.
- Yes : Show carousel arrow borders.

Compact WebKit :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the left sidebar on the WebKit home page.

- Hide : Hide the left sidebar.
- Show : Show the left sidebar.

Event background :.description:
> Choose the background used by Steam event pages.

- Black background : Replace the event artwork with a dark background.
- Default background : Show the default event artwork.

Event header :.description:
> Choose whether to display the event artwork header on the WebKit home page.

- Hide : Hide the event artwork header.
- Minimal Dark default : Show the event artwork header.

Hide '+ Add a Showcase' :.description:
> Choose whether to hide the "+ Add a Showcase" control on your Steam profile.

- No : Show the control.
- Yes : Hide the control.

Note : When hidden, you cannot add a new showcase until this option is disabled.

Hide footers :.description:
> Choose whether to hide legal information in WebKit page footers.

- Hide : Hide footer legal information.
- Show : Show footer legal information.

Hide VAC ban information on profiles :.description:
> Choose whether to hide VAC ban information on user profiles.

- No : Show VAC ban information.
- Yes : Hide VAC ban information.

Profile borders :.description:
> Choose whether to display borders around blocks on profile pages.

- No : Hide profile block borders.
- Yes : Show profile block borders.

Profile headers :.description:
> Choose the header style used on Steam profile pages.

- Minimal (for Steam profile themes) : Use Minimal styling while preserving colors from Steam profile themes.
- Minimal default : Use the default Minimal Dark headers.
- Vanilla profiles : Use Steam's vanilla profile headers.

Profiles :.description:
> Choose whether profile blocks use blurred or solid backgrounds.

- Minimal Dark : Use blurred blocks.
- No blurred blocks : Use solid black blocks.

Solid profile background color :.description:
> Choose whether profile pages display custom artwork or a solid dark background.

- Default : Show profile images and videos.
- Solid color : Use a solid dark background without images or videos.

URL bar :.description:
> Choose whether the URL bar is always visible, always hidden, or shown only on hover.

- Hide : Hide the URL bar.
- Show only on hover : Show the URL bar only on hover.
- Visible : Keep the URL bar visible.
